projects.title: mobius-x1
projects.dek: Beating a 1937 recipe, eventually: the GF(2) Möbius transform below N log N.
projects.one_line: A claimed, AI-assisted proof that the subset-parity (Möbius/zeta) transform over GF(2) needs asymptotically fewer XOR gates than Yates' 1937 ½·N·log₂N recipe, built by transplanting an AI-generated OpenAI Fourier-transform construction into bit arithmetic; the saving appears only when k has billions of digits. Aska's agentic team contributed the full-network check of the strongest version (Theorem 2).

It comes with a free in-browser demo that searches 161,282 official US code entries and says plainly that keyword matching is not understanding.
